fields.description: The id a client sends after the provider's prefix (deepseek-v4.1-flash, claude-sonnet-5-5). One record per id, whoever serves it; a Model under each provider record links it. Lowercased on save, with spaces and underscores as dashes ('Qwen3.5 Coder' → qwen3.5-coder). The name, so it is set once.
